1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bb5 a6 5.B.strategy: Wins the pawn on the surface, but Black gets it back by force with a knight offer and a queen fork. White is left with the better pawn structure, but not an extra pawn; a quieter move keeps more of the structural edge.

The tactical point: the knight takes e4, and if White takes it back the queen forks both white knights from d4. Black regains the pawn, keeps the bishop pair and gets open lines, in return for the doubled c-pawns.
